SELECT `comments`.* FROM `comments` WHERE `comments`.`commentable_id` = 1 AND `comments`.`commentable_type` = 'User' AND `comments`.`comment_type` = 'on' AND `comments`.`author_name` IN ('pause_payouts_after_repeated_failures', 'pause_payouts_for_seller_based_on_chargeback_rate') ORDER BY `comments`.`created_at` DESC, `comments`.`id` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT `active_storage_attachments`.* FROM `active_storage_attachments` WHERE `active_storage_attachments`.`record_id` = 1 AND `active_storage_attachments`.`record_type` = 'User' AND `active_storage_attachments`.`name` = 'avatar' LIMIT 1
ROLLBACK

statements.sql: SELECT `users`.* FROM `users` WHERE `users`.`id` = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT `comments`.* FROM `comments` WHERE `comments`.`commentable_id` = 1 AND `comments`.`commentable_type` = 'User' AND `comments`.`comment_type` = 'on' AND `comments`.`author_name` IN ('pause_payouts_after_repeated_failures', 'pause_payouts_for_seller_based_on_chargeback_rate') ORDER BY `comments`.`created_at` DESC, `comments`.`id` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(purchases.price_cents), 0), COUNT(CASE WHEN purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & 512 = 0 THEN 1 END), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & 512 = 0 THEN purchases.price_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM `purchases` WHERE `purchases`.`seller_id` = 1 AND `purchases`.`purchase_state` = 'successful' AND (purchases.stripe_refunded IS NULL OR purchases.stripe_refunded = 0) AND ((`purchases`.`flags` & 67108864 = 0)) AND (COALESCE(purchases.charge_processor_id, '') != 'paypal') AND (purchases.created_at >= '2025-11-04 12:30:45.123000') LIMIT 1

fields: COUNT(CASE WHEN purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & 512 = 0 THEN 1 END)
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & 512 = 0 THEN purchases.price_cents ELSE 0 END), 0)
